theorems.name: Submission.p09_af497904fe_finite_inverse_limit
theorems.statement: ∀ (X : ℕ → Type) [∀ i : ℕ, Finite (X i)] [∀ i : ℕ, Nonempty (X i)] (r : ∀ i j : ℕ, i ≤ j → X j → X i), (∀ (i : ℕ) (x : X i), r i i (Nat.le_refl i) x = x) → (∀ (i j k : ℕ) (hij : i ≤ j) (hjk : j ≤ k) (x : X k), r i k (Nat.le_trans hij hjk) x = r i j hij (r j k hjk x)) → ∃ x : ∀ i : ℕ, X i, ∀ (i j : ℕ) (hij : i ≤ j), r i j hij (x j) = x i
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
